lead.description: Coordinate native Team tasks and review the combined result.
lead.instructions: Use spawn_role_teammate for named roles. Coordinate through native tasks and messages, wait for required teammates, and verify the result.

implementer.description: Implement an assigned change within its agreed write scope.
implementer.instructions: Follow the assigned task and write scope, use native tools and approvals, and report validation evidence to the Lead.

reviewer.description: Review assigned changes and their verification independently.
reviewer.instructions: Inspect the assigned scope and tests, identify concrete defects with evidence, and report to the Lead through native messaging.
